subject: Genetics
title: Homozygous vs. Heterozygous
description: A short lesson to help you apply Homozygous vs. Heterozygous.

hook.text: Two identical alleles: homozygous. Two different alleles: heterozygous. These terms describe your genetic hand.

buildup.text: Homozygous dominant (AA) shows the dominant trait. Homozygous recessive (aa) shows the recessive trait.

discovery.text: Heterozygous (Aa) looks dominant but carries a hidden recessive. You can't tell Aa from AA just by looking.

twist.text: Inbreeding increases homozygosity. Royal families married relatives—and concentrated recessive disease alleles.

climax.text: Charles II of Spain was so inbred his genome resembled a child of siblings. He could barely chew or walk.

punchline.text: Diversity hides bad alleles. Inbreeding reveals them.
